title: RavenAdminSystem
description: Everything you need to manage your server — in one plugin. No extra setup, no hassle. Install and start working.
body:
**Raven Admin System** is a powerful, ready-to-use moderation tool for Minecraft servers running on Paper/Purpur cores. You **don't need to spend hours configuring it**, install dozens of additional plugins, or figure out complex configurations. Everything works immediately after installation.

The plugin includes:
- Question/Answer system for player support
- Player reporting system
- Complete punishment system: mute, kick, warnings, ban (temporary and permanent), IP-ban
- Jail with automatic movement control
- Admin chat
- Rank system (Helper → Moderator → Admin → Senior Admin)
- Vanish mode
- Player freeze
- Panic mode — mass freeze of violators in radius
- God mode
- And much more

---

## 🔥 Why is Raven Admin System?

| Problem | Solution |
|---------|----------|
| Need to install 5-10 plugins | **All-in-one** — one plugin replaces an entire set |
| Hours of config tweaking | **Ready to use** — all default values are optimal |
| Complex permissions | **Ready-made permission system** — 5 ranks with pre-configured permissions |
| Data loss on reload | **Auto-save** — all punishments persist in YAML |
| Manual permission assignment | **Rank promotion via command** — `/agiverank` |
| Hard to track punishment history | **Full punishment log** — `/history` |

---

## ⚙️ Features

### 👤 For players
- Ask helpers questions — `/ask <question>`
- Report violators — `/report <player> <reason>`

### 🛡️ For Helpers
- Answer questions — `/ans <player> <answer>`
- View question list — `/ask list`
- Use admin chat — `/ac <message>`
- View player punishment history — `/history <player>`

### 🔨 For Moderators
- Mute, kick, jail, vanish, teleportation
- View muted and jailed players lists
- Private messages, chat clear, spectate
- Work with reports — `/reports`

### ⚡ For Admins
- Warnings with auto-ban after 3 violations
- Ban (temporary/permanent), unban, ban list
- View inventory and ender chest
- Player teleportation, freeze, heal, set on fire
- Panic — freeze all players in radius

### 👑 For Senior Admins
- Assign helpers and promote ranks
- Admin warnings (7 days, 3 = ban)
- IP-ban, inventory clear, give items
- God mode, mass teleportation
- Complete player permission reset

---

## 📋 Commands

### 🔹 Common commands (visible to all)

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/ask <question>` | Ask a question to helpers |
| `/report <player> <reason>` | Report a player |

### 🔹 Admin Chat

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/ac <message>` | Send a message to admin chat |


### 🔹 Helper commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/ahelp` | Show all available commands |
| `/ask list` | List of questions (Helper+ only) |
| `/ans <player> <answer>` | Answer a question |
| `/history [player]` | Punishment history |

### 🔹 Moderator commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/mute <player> <minutes> [reason]` | Mute a player |
| `/unmute <player>` | Unmute a player |
| `/mutelist` | List of muted players |
| `/kick <player> [reason]` | Kick a player |
| `/tpto <player>` | Teleport to a player |
| `/vanish` | Become invisible |
| `/feed [player]` | Feed a player |
| `/jail <player> <minutes> <reason>` | Jail a player |
| `/unjail <player>` | Unjail a player |
| `/jaillist` | List of jailed players |
| `/pm <player> <message>` | Private message |
| `/clearchat` | Clear the chat |
| `/spec <player>` | Spectate a player |
| `/reports` | List of reports |

### 🔹 Admin commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/warn <player> <days> <reason>` | Issue a warning |
| `/unwarn <player> <number>` | Remove a warning |
| `/warnlist` | List of warnings |
| `/ban <player> <days> <reason>` | Ban a player (-1 = permanent) |
| `/unban <player>` | Unban a player |
| `/banlist` | List of banned players |
| `/inv <player>` | View inventory |
| `/ec <player>` | View ender chest |
| `/tphere <player>` | Teleport player to you |
| `/tpp <player1> <player2>` | Teleport player to player |
| `/spawn [player]` | Send to spawn |
| `/freeze <player>` | Freeze/unfreeze a player |
| `/kill <player>` | Kill a player |
| `/heal [player]` | Heal a player |
| `/panic [radius]` | Freeze all players in radius |
| `/burn <player> <seconds>` | Set a player on fire |
| `/ext [player]` | Extinguish a player |

### 🔹 Senior Admin commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/jailpoint` | Set jail location |
| `/sethelper <player>` | Assign a helper |
| `/agiverank <player>` | Promote a player's rank |
| `/awarn <player> <reason>` | Issue an admin warning |
| `/aunwarn <player> <number>` | Remove an admin warning |
| `/banip <player> <reason>` | Ban IP address permanently |
| `/unbanip <ip>` | Unban IP address |
| `/clear <player>` | Clear inventory |
| `/give <player> <item> <amount>` | Give an item |
| `/god` | Toggle god mode |
| `/tphereall` | Teleport all players to you |
| `/unadmin <player>` | Reset all admin permissions |
| `/admin reload` | Reload configuration |

---

## 🔐 Permissions

### Basic permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `adminsystem.use` | Ask questions and send reports | All players |

### Staff permissions

| Permission | Rank |
|------------|------|
| `adminsystem.helper` | Helper |
| `adminsystem.moderator` | Moderator |
| `adminsystem.admin` | Admin |
| `adminsystem.senior` | Senior Admin |

> **Important:** All permissions are automatically assigned through the rank system. You don't need to manually configure them!

---

## ⭐ Advantages

### ✅ Ready "out of the box"
- Install → start → it works
- All settings are already optimal
- No need to spend hours tweaking configs

### ✅ All-in-one plugin
- Replaces 5-10 separate plugins
- No conflicts between modules
- Unified permission and command system

### ✅ Simple rank system
- Only 5 ranks
- Single command promotion — `/agiverank`
- Permissions assigned automatically

### ✅ Auto-save
- All punishments persist in YAML files
- Nothing is lost on server restart
- Automatic cleanup of expired punishments

### ✅ Bilingual support
- Full English language support
- Easy to switch to Other
- All messages are customizable

### ✅ Security
- Protection against muting/kicking/jailing staff members
- IP-ban for serious violators
- Complete punishment history

### ✅ Performance
- Asynchronous operations
- Optimized question and report queues
- Minimal server load


---

## 🎯 Who is this plugin for?

- **Server owners** — get a ready-made moderation system
- **Admins** — all tools in one place
- **Moderators** — clear commands and logic
- **Players** — quick help and protection from violators

---

## 📥 Installation

1. Download `RavenAdminSystem.jar`
2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Done! The plugin is working.

> **Supported cores:** Paper, Purpur, Spigot (versions 1.20+)

---
**Raven Admin System — your reliable server management assistant! 🚀**
